🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: mixed sector returns (only Tech, Energy, Industrials, Materials positive) and narrow leadership (Top 5 all Technology) with a major divergence across large caps (≥3 large names with 1W ≠ 1M), so restraint warranted.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leads: IBM (1W: +31.33% | 1M: +42.83%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +27.75% | 1M: +40.03%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +26.69% | 1M: +42.34%) ABOVE TREND. Materials and Industrials show follow-through: FCX (1W: +11.44% | 1M: +26.83%) ABOVE TREND and DE (1W: +9.47% | 1M: +0.34%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Healthcare, Real Estate and Utilities lag: ISRG (1W: -7.86% | 1M: -12.12%) BELOW TREND, WELL (1W: -10.44% | 1M: -9.63%) BELOW TREND, CEG (1W: -9.59% | 1M: -11.29%) BELOW TREND. Communication and Financials also under pressure with GOOGL (1W: -6.95% | 1M: -6.18%) BELOW TREND and CME (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -13.47%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: IBM (1W: +31.33% | 1M: +42.83%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +27.75% | 1M: +40.03%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +26.69% | 1M: +42.34%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +15.75% | 1M: +64.12%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +14.31%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (Top 5 all Technology) — concentration risk present.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: BMY (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -6.46%) BELOW TREND, SYK (1W: -6.29% | 1M: -0.49%) BELOW TREND, WMB (1W: -6.59% | 1M: -5.60%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -6.95% | 1M: -6.18%) BELOW TREND, ISRG (1W: -7.86% | 1M: -12.12%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated across Healthcare and select Financials/Comm names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W moves: IBM (1W: +31.33% | 1M: +42.83%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +27.75% | 1M: +40.03%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +26.69% | 1M: +42.34%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +15.75% | 1M: +64.12%) ABOVE TREND, CRM (1W: +12.15% | 1M: +9.26%) ABOVE TREND. Watch for divergences: SHOP (1W: +11.54% | 1M: -8.35%) RECOVERY and INTC (1W: -12.62% | 1M: +8.34%) CORRECTION signal mixed momentum.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech mixed but leadership concentrated: IBM (1W: +31.33% | 1M: +42.83%) ABOVE TREND and ORCL (1W: +26.69% | 1M: +42.34%) ABOVE TREND show strong accumulation while GOOGL (1W: -6.95% | 1M: -6.18%) BELOW TREND and META (1W: -2.40% | 1M: -1.83%) BELOW TREND show divergence. Sector 1W: +7.50% (24 stocks) — gains narrow and require follow-through.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials weak on 1W: JPM (1W: -1.88% | 1M: -3.68%) BELOW TREND and CME (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -13.47%) BELOW TREND highlight dispersion; UNH is not a Financial but cross-market stress seen. Sector 1W: -0.67% (20 stocks) — internal weakness, monitor for rebounds in select names.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare shows weakness and headline-driven dispersion: BMY (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -6.46%) BELOW TREND and ISRG (1W: -7.86% | 1M: -12.12%) BELOW TREND contrast with UNH (1W: +0.28% | 1M: +2.48%) ABOVE TREND. Sector 1W: -2.06% (17 stocks) — watch headline sensitivity and legal/regulatory catalysts.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective Technology and cyclical names showing ABOVE TREND (IBM (1W: +31.33% | 1M: +42.83%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +26.69% | 1M: +42.34%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +11.44% | 1M: +26.83%) ABOVE TREND) and monitor Industrials (DE (1W: +9.47% | 1M: +0.34%) ABOVE TREND). Reduce exposure to names with confirmed BELOW TREND pressure and headline risk (GOOGL (1W: -6.95% | 1M: -6.18%) BELOW TREND, ISRG (1W: -7.86% | 1M: -12.12%) BELOW TREND); style mixed / no clear leadership.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: IBM (1W: +31.33% | 1M: +42.83%) ABOVE TREND — momentum continuation candidate; PANW (1W: +15.75% | 1M: +64.12%) ABOVE TREND — earnings sentiment supportive; SHOP (1W: +11.54% | 1M: -8.35%) RECOVERY — repurchase news confirming short-term bounce. BEARISH: GOOGL (1W: -6.95% | 1M: -6.18%) BELOW TREND — downside continuation risk; CME (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -13.47%) BELOW TREND — headline weakness confirmed; INTC (1W: -12.62% | 1M: +8.34%) CORRECTION — watch for trend break.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (1W: +7.50%) and Materials (1W: +0.99%) given concentrated leaders and momentum; Industrials (1W: +1.11%) for cyclical exposure. BEARISH: Healthcare (1W: -2.06%), Real Estate (1W: -3.56%) and Utilities (1W: -3.39%) where weakness and headline risk persist; overall Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch continuation or failure of the recent Tech leaders' run: IBM and ORCL sustaining another 1W > +10% would confirm broadening; failure to hold this week's gains in ORCL (1W: +26.69% | 1M: +42.34%) would signal distribution. Monitor INTC (1W: -12.62% | 1M: +8.34%) for a CORRECTION breakdown and SHOP (1W: +11.54% | 1M: -8.35%) for follow-through above the 1W move as confirmation.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
SHOP (+80): Shopify (1W: +11.54% | 1M: -8.35%) RECOVERY — share repurchase news confirmed by a strong 1W move but monthly remains negative. PANW (+55): Palo Alto (1W: +15.75% | 1M: +64.12%) ABOVE TREND — earnings/AI commentary confirming price strength. BMY (+75): BMY (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -6.46%) BELOW TREND — EU label expansion headline but price is falling, divergence to monitor. WELL (+55): Welltower (1W: -10.44% | 1M: -9.63%) BELOW TREND — dividend hike headline but price declines indicate distribution.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
PLTR (-60): Palantir (1W: +11.40% | 1M: +5.62%) ABOVE TREND — political headline but price up, clear divergence and distribution risk. UNH (-55): UnitedHealth (1W: +0.28% | 1M: +2.48%) ABOVE TREND — lawsuit headline introduces downside risk despite above-trend price. TSLA (-50): Tesla (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +8.42%) CORRECTION — legal headlines align with short-term weakness. CME (-45): CME Group (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -13.47%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price both confirm downside.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. IBM (1W: +31.33% | 1M: +42.83%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +26.69% | 1M: +42.34%) ABOVE TREND and FCX (1W: +11.44% | 1M: +26.83%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: narrow Tech leadership and major divergence across large caps (SHOP, INTC, PLTR) while breadth remains shallow (4/11), so monitor headlines and trend confirmation.
